profile.headline: DevOps/System Administrator | AWS | Terraform | Cisco | Git | CI/CD | Cloud Computing | Network
profile.summary:
Implement proof of concepts to gain leadership buy in. Collaborative problem solver, providing effective negotiation approaches. Excel in fast paced environments; keen on learning new technologies and adopting creative solutions for improving IT services.

During my time as a system administrator I used VMware to manage systems for both traditional software products and software as a service product. This was done by creating a PowerCLI script that included PowerShell commands to harden the server. Then as my role evolved to include Terraform and AWS. I deployed infrastructure as code to create various AWS environments along with K8S. 

Software: Terraform, Jenkins, GitHub
Operating Systems: Windows Server 2008 / 2012 / 2016 / 2019, Cisco NSX / IOS, Centos
Applications: AWS, Docker, K8S

Bi-lingual; English and Spanish fluent

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Aegis credit card over limit messaging deployment team member:
  Setup AWS infrastructure
  Created Terraform scripts to automate the AWS infrastructure setup
  Created back-end Java application
  Ensured that cybersecurity break against both our Terraform and AWS infrastructure were addressed and closed
Everest SRE team member:
   Created python automation script with the assistance of Microsoft Copilot
   Ensured that cybersecurity breaks against our Terraform and AWS infrastructure were addressed and closed.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Aegis SRE team supporting our developers, and help to release code to various environments. 
Updated infrastructure code to use project Calico for K8S.
Ensured that production back engine to calculate risk on new credit card applications was online and functioning as expected.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description: Assigned release engineer duties collaborating with 7 software engineers to release code between 3 environments. Designed and implemented application infrastructure life cycle in 3 environments. Planned and executed software and hardware installations and upgrades in 3 environments. Implemented VMware 6.5 to administrator production infrastructure. Planned and executed PowerBi Gateway in 2 environments (development and production).
positions.insights: Skills: Active Directory · Infrastructure · Jenkins · Windows Server · DevOps · VMware vSphere · System Administration

positions.title: Transportation Security Officer
positions.description: Screened passengers in airport terminal for potential threats to other passengers and aircraft. Interacted with airline passengers, giving directions and responding to inquiries on daily basis in 4 airport terminals.

positions.title: VSAT Engineer
positions.description: Led site assessments for startup camps, and maintained commercial network on military camp. Oversaw site assessments for Vsat installment at 5 startup camps to install commercial internet at camps. Managed Leatherneck network consisting of 50 nodes including routers, switches, and wireless access points, maintaining camp’s network.
positions.insights: Skills: Active Directory · Infrastructure · Network Administration · Networking · Routers · Security · System Administration

positions.title: Network Engineer, Mid
positions.description: Maintained commercial network on military camps and established satellite connection. Maintained Afghanistan network consisting between 2 to 100 nodes per camp using combination of SolarWinds and Spiceworks for monitoring.
positions.insights: Skills: Infrastructure · Network Administration · Networking · Routers · Security · System Administration

educations.fieldOfStudy: Technical Management Concentration in Game and Simulation Programming
